inputs.text: I can't believe what I'm hearing out of Indiana earlier this month. Some judge there went and blocked a law aimed at protecting unborn life, and now the ACLU along with this Hoosier Jews for Choice group is claiming the whole thing violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs. They're calling it a big victory against forcing one narrow worldview on everyone, but that's just code for letting abortion activists hide behind religion to keep killing babies. Conservative outlets like LifeNews are right to call it what it is: this judge thinks killing babies in abortions is a religious right. It's the same old progressive push to undermine traditional family values, personal responsibility, and the basic authority of laws that respect the sanctity of life over radical reinterpretations of freedom.
